name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including authenticated Redis, runtime and log directories, service enablement, and a cleanup workaround for replication-related settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a Python FastAPI tutorial application from Git, installs Python and PostgreSQL dependencies, configures a virtual environment and database, and runs Uvicorn under systemd.

name: nginx-multisite
description: Builds an Nginx multi-site web tier for three data-bag-defined subdomains, including static content, TLS certificates, firewall rules, fail2ban, sysctl settings, and SSH hardening.
